_source: World explained Short, Florida Learjet crash, 2.5M views, 1:54. Built-in browser 2026-11-20: frames at 0, 5, 22, 50, 85 s. SAMPLED. Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: top-down: a white jet diving over a city grid with an orange trail; a vertical-speed meter panel at the top; a tag 'reconstructed, not original audio'; boxed caption starting with the distress call
hook.firstLine: A reconstructed distress call opens the Short.

shots.picture: top-down dive over a city grid, orange trail, vertical-speed meter, reconstructed-audio tag
flat stylised map: cyan route turning orange where the descent starts, a white ring at the impact point; meter reads minus ten thousand
side view: flat-shaded jet with a cyan trail in level flight between painted clouds on navy; meter reads LEVEL
three-quarter view of the jet diving, orange trail, dark storm sky; the reconstructed-audio tag returns
close-up of a wing's leading edge with jagged ice, a cyan callout line 'ice reported'

whyItWorks: A persistent instrument (the vertical-speed meter) sits in every shot; its reading carries the tension.
Opens on a reconstructed radio call, labelled as reconstructed: sound first, picture explains.
Captions boxed, the spoken word bolded and underlined.
A colour rule: cyan path while normal, orange once the descent starts.
